title: A Redundancy Reduction Approach for Controllable Sequential Recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2609.23849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential recommendation must operate under long-tailed item distributions and popularity-driven concentration, often forcing practitioners to trade short-list accuracy against long-tail exposure. In this work, we study feature decorrelation as a mechanism for shaping representation geometry in dot-product sequential recommenders, and analyze how this, in turn, affects popularity-driven concentration. We propose a decorrelation-regularized training framework that augments next-item prediction with an auxiliary redundancy-reduction term, and instantiate it with BT-SR, which uses the Barlow Twins objective. To form label-consistent positive pairs without synthetic corruptions, we pair user histories that share the same next-item target. translated_title: 一种用于可控序列推荐的冗余削减方法
translated_abstract: 序列推荐必须在长尾物品分布和流行度驱动的集中现象下运行，这常常迫使从业者在短列表准确率与长尾曝光之间进行权衡。在这项工作中，我们研究特征去相关作为一种机制，用于塑造点积序列推荐器中的表示几何结构，并分析这反过来如何影响流行度驱动的集中现象。我们提出了一种去相关正则化训练框架，该框架通过辅助冗余削减项来增强下一物品预测，并用BT-SR进行实例化，后者采用Barlow Twins目标函数。为了在不使用合成数据增强的情况下构建标签一致的正样本对，我们将共享相同下一物品目标的用户历史进行配对。除了准确率之外，我们还提供了几何分析，展示去相关如何抑制用户表示空间中可能给流行物品带来全局评分优势的共享低秩方向，并且……
tldr: 提出了一种基于Barlow Twins目标的去相关正则化训练框架BT-SR，通过冗余削减塑造用户表示的几何结构，抑制流行物品在评分中的全局优势，从而在提升序列推荐准确率的同时缓解流行度集中问题、改善长尾物品曝光。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BT-SR, a decorrelation-regularized training framework based on the Barlow Twins objective, which shapes user representation geometry through redundancy reduction to suppress the global scoring advantage of popular items, thereby improving sequential recommendation accuracy while mitigating popularity-driven concentration and enhancing long-tail exposure.
